    Is Troy University a D1 school?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Troy University is a Division I school. They compete in the NCAA Division I (FBS) as a member of the Sun Belt Conference for nearly all sports. Troy has 16 Division I athletic teams, nicknamed the Trojans. 
    • Athletic Division: NCAA Division I (Football Bowl Subdivision - FBS).
    • Conference: Sun Belt Conference.
    • Location: Troy, Alabama.
    • Nickname: Trojans. 
    The Trojans have competed at the Division I-A level (now FBS) for football since 2001
